notes.title: Minor Update (#0.034), February 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have made a few small changes in response to feedback.

[b]Update 0.034 Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Additional performance setting: VSync
[*] Slight gameplay tweaks: dialogue, environment, easter eggs
[/list]
Thank you everyone for all of the feedback you have provided!
Not only will I use this feedback on updating The New Apartment, but I will consider it for future projects as well.

Sincerely,
Paul Thomas.

notes.title: The New Apartment is ON SALE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. The New Apartment is finally out for release!
Thank you to everyone who made this possible.

[previewyoutube=llPejHdxhPc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]First Week Offer[/b]
You can purchase the game with a 25% off sale from now through February 7th.

[b]Future Plans[/b]
I can't wait to hear back from you all with your thoughts--I really enjoy creating these games and have many more ideas to build upon in the future. I will keep you all updated! I appreciate all of the support on YouTube and Steam--it means a lot to me.

[b]Sincerely,[/b]
Paul Thomas.
